limits: This file records what was checked, with the date it was checked. It is not a live feed, and nothing in CI reaches the corpus: the guard can only hold our prose to this record, never refresh it.
A vector may be described as published only while its status here is `published`, and every paragraph that states corpus status must cite this file by path so a reader can date the claim.
Statuses are `accepted-not-published` and `published`; there is no third state, because 'submitted' and 'in review' are how a commitment gets quoted as an entry.
